edits.before: 在训练数据方面，论辩结构标注需要同时确定文本片段、论辩角色及其连接，数据构建成本较高[1][2]。利用语言模型改写已有文本，可以增加表达形式，为扩充训练样本提供途径[15]；然而，文本表达发生变化后，原有标注是否仍然成立需要检查。两段文字即使主题相同，也可能在立场、论述范围或理由强度上存在差异，从而影响组件的角色以及对其他组件的支持关系。已有槽位化增强方法通过保持语义来沿用标注[35]，但对于组件与关系相互依赖的任务，还需要进一步判断哪些监督信息能够可靠保留。

edits.before: 对上述问题开展研究，具有方法与应用两方面的意义。在方法层面，论辩挖掘同时涉及文本语义、组件角色和关系结构。考察文本改写后监督信息的保留条件，有助于明确数据增强在结构化任务中的使用边界；研究组件变化对关联关系的影响，则有助于分析局部修正与完整结构之间的联系。这些问题能够为论辩挖掘的训练与预测方法提供更具体的设计依据，也可为其他包含对象依赖的结构化抽取任务提供研究思路。
edits.after: 对上述问题开展研究，具有方法与应用两方面的意义。在方法层面，论辩挖掘同时涉及文本语义、组件角色和关系结构。考察文本改写后监督信息的保留条件，有助于明确数据增强在结构化任务中的使用边界；研究组件变化对关联关系的影响，则有助于分析局部修正与完整结构之间的联系。对这些问题的研究能够为论辩挖掘的训练与预测方法提供更具体的设计依据，也可为其他包含对象依赖的结构化抽取任务提供研究思路。

edits.old_text: End-to-end argument mining identifies text spans, argumentative roles, and directed relations. Component–relation dependencies create cascading effects during both local paraphrasing and prediction repair. This thesis investigates dependency maintenance in training and inference, building on multi-candidate reranking and bounded repair.
edits.new_text: End-to-end argument mining requires the joint identification of text spans, argumentative roles, and directed relations. Dependencies between components and relations create challenges at two stages: local paraphrasing can invalidate training labels, and component edits can invalidate relation endpoints during prediction repair. Building on multi-candidate reranking and bounded repair, this thesis studies dependency maintenance during training and inference.

edits.old_text: For training, relation influence domains identify internal, cross-boundary, and NONE factors. Lossless annotation transport and factor masks define reliable correspondences for auxiliary supervision and paired distribution alignment, while original documents retain full-graph generation targets. For inference, dependency-closed transactions jointly reconsider component changes and all affected relations under frozen full-object scores, separate utility gates, and edit budgets. Local and global optimization share the same object identity and constraints. CDCP collective-source relations are evaluated as complete native hyperedges.
edits.new_text: During training, relation influence domains identify internal, cross-boundary, and NONE factors. Lossless annotation transport and factor-level masks establish reliable correspondences for auxiliary supervision and paired distribution alignment, while original documents retain full-graph generation targets. During inference, dependency-closed transactions jointly reconsider component changes and all affected relations. Frozen full-object scores, separate utility gates, and edit budgets determine whether to accept a transaction. Local and global optimization use the same object identities and structural constraints. Multi-source relations in CDCP are evaluated as complete native hyperedges.

edits.old_text: In scenario records with Qwen3.5-9B under free-cardinality evaluation, the complete system achieves strict relation F1 of 71.63 on AAEC and 50.77 on CDCP, exceeding the same-backbone ICIC/MCR-BR baseline by 5.94 and 8.98 points. Both additional inference effects and the CDCP training effect pass Holm correction over fourteen primary comparisons; the positive AAEC training effect does not. Supplementary four-cell comparisons use Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen2.5-7B with shared augmentation. Weak-score abstention and traceable corpus cases retain the method’s limits.
edits.new_text: On the official AAEC and CDCP test splits under free-cardinality evaluation, the complete Qwen3.5-9B configuration achieves strict relation F1 scores of 71.63 and 50.77, exceeding the same-backbone ICIC/MCR-BR baseline by 5.94 and 8.98 percentage points. With I0 fixed, the training gains are 2.56 and 3.30 points; with T1 fixed, the additional repair gains are 3.38 and 5.68 points. After Holm correction across fourteen primary comparisons, both additional inference gains and the CDCP training gain are statistically significant, whereas the AAEC training gain is not. Supplementary experiments with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct support transfer under shared augmentation. Weak-score abstention and failure cases show that improved fixed utility does not guarantee better extraction for every instance.

edits.old_text: 本章在统一协议下，将两阶段的总体表现、关系恢复来源和漏检分布联系起来。四格结果显示两阶段分别对应正向的条件增量，对象分析进一步表明，两条单独路径能够覆盖部分不同的关系，但组合过程仍会丢失少量初始TP，且交互区间尚不足以确认稳定协同。端点缺失和关系评分门限构成当前记录中的主要阻断，CDCP长源集合则保留了明显的恢复困难。因此，整体配置的改善、具体机制的独立贡献及复杂对象的适用范围应分别判断，成对项、共同接受、集合动作和重生成比较仍以各自受控分析为依据。
edits.new_text: 本章结合总体指标、完整关系对象和漏检分布分析了两阶段的组合效果。四种配置均显示正向的阶段条件增量，其中AAEC训练增量未通过主要比较族的Holm校正。两条单独路径恢复的关系部分不同，但完整配置仍会丢失部分原有正确关系，交互区间也不足以确认稳定协同。终态端点缺失与评分未过门是当前漏检诊断中的主要环节，CDCP长源集合的恢复仍然困难。共享增强条件下的跨骨干结果补充了方法的适用性证据；具体机制的贡献仍需结合各自受控比较判断。
